highlights.title: Libre 3/3+ pairing and LibreLoop update
changes: Libre 3/3+ support now uses RoundWhiteDiscKit and an updated LibreLoop branch.
Pairing now uses and verifies a host-supplied app credential for Libre 3/3+ sensors.
Pairing selects the sensor by the BLE address from the NFC scan to avoid choosing nearby sensors.
Settings → Debug Info shows the sensor security version, region, and the app credential used to pair.
The minute-by-minute forwarding toggle is hidden so forwarding stays at Trio's 5-minute cadence, and the settings title.

changes: No immediate user-facing changes in the Trio app.
Build scripts were changed to remove LibreCRKit and to use OmnipodKit's dev branch by default.
Multiple submodules for sensors, pumps, and algorithms were updated to match Loop v3.14.9.

includedPullRequests.title: Replace LibreCRKit with RoundWhiteDiscKit and track LoopKit's LibreLoop
includedPullRequests.body:
Moves Trio's Libre 3 / 3+ support onto RoundWhiteDiscKit and current LibreLoop.

## Changes

- **RoundWhiteDiscKit** ([loopandlearn/RoundWhiteDiscKit](https://github.com/loopandlearn/RoundWhiteDiscKit) `main`, `e66da6c`, a fork of airedev326/RoundWhiteDiscKit) replaces LibreCRKit: submodule, workspace entry, the app's local package reference and link.
- **LibreLoop** moves from `loopandlearn/LibreLoop@trio` to [`loopandlearn/LibreLoop@legacy-loopkit-compat`](https://github.com/loopandlearn/LibreLoop/tree/legacy-loopkit-compat) (`c6e9cc1`): current LibreLoop `main` plus what's needed to build against loopandlearn's LoopKit (HKQuantity instead of LoopQuantity, `CGMManagerStatus` without `inSensorWarmup`/`isInoperable`, completion-handler `acknowledgeAlert`, `LoopKit.`-qualified glucose types, an `HKUnit` shim), plus the trio branch's two Trio-specific choices: the minute-by-minute forwarding toggle hidden, and the settings title.
- `scripts/swiftformat.sh` excludes `RoundWhiteDiscKit`; `define_common_trio.sh` and CODEOWNERS follow the rename, and `define_common_trio.sh` lists `loopandlearn:LibreLoop:legacy-loopkit-compat` and `loopandlearn:RoundWhiteDiscKit:main`, so every submodule comes from loopandlearn again.

## What this brings

- **Pairing with an app credential.** RoundWhiteDiscKit pairs with a host-supplied app credential (certificate + P-256 key); LibreLoop downloads it and verifies it against a pinned digest. Tested on a US-region Libre 3 Plus.
- **Sensor selection by BLE address.** Pairing matches the sensor's advertised name against the BLE address from the NFC scan, so another Libre-family sensor nearby (e.g. a Lingo) can't win the scan.
- Recent LibreLoop fixes, including stale sensor-expiry alerts being retracted when the CGM is deleted.
- **Settings → Debug Info** shows the sensor's security version, region, and the app credential it paired with. Reports from Libre 3 users here, especially non-US sensors, would be very useful.

## Behaviour versus `loopandlearn/LibreLoop@trio`

Same Trio-specific choices as the trio branch: the **minute-by-minute forwarding** toggle is hidden, so forwarding stays at Trio's 5-minute cadence, and the settings screen is titled "FreeStyle Libre 3 / 3+", set on the hosting controller as well as in SwiftUI.

## Relation to nightscout/Trio#1602

nightscout/Trio#1602 makes the same LibreCRKit → RoundWhiteDiscKit move. It pins RoundWhiteDiscKit `e409216`, which no longer exists after that repository's history was rewritten, and it waits on loopandlearn/LibreLoop#1. This PR uses a RoundWhiteDiscKit commit that is on `main`, and a LibreLoop branch that is already published.

## Testing

Built locally from a fresh recursive clone of this branch (no LibreCRKit on disk): the **Trio** scheme builds for the iOS Simulator, compiling LibreLoop and RoundWhiteDiscKit. That was with Xcode 27, using `CI=true` (skips SwiftFormat, as CI does) and `SWIFT_ENABLE_EXPLICIT_MODULES=NO`, because under Xcode 27's explicit modules even current `dev` fails on LibreLoop's implicit `LoopAlgorithm` import. Trio's CI uses Xcode 26, so its run here is the real check.

Device pairing was tested with LoopWorkspace (same LibreLoop and RoundWhiteDiscKit, newer LoopKit), not yet with Trio.

includedPullRequests.title: Update scripts and selected submodules
includedPullRequests.body:
## Purpose

Update submodules and modify one script.

Most of the Trio submodules should be at parity with those same submodules used by Loop v3.14.9.

> warning, before using scripts/update_submodules_trio.sh, ensure the loopandlearn forks are up to date

### Method

This PR has 4 commits because I messed up the second one.

scripts changes: scripts/define_common_trio.sh
* remove LibreCRKit from the list of PROJECTS
* change the default branch to OmnipodKit dev instead of OmnipodKit main

Submodule Changes - point to the tip of the main/dev/trio branch as directed by the PROJECTS in the updated scripts/define_common_trio.sh script, with the exception that LibreLoop is not updated. That is handled by a different PR.

I checked the submodule details and realized
* I committed a change to LibreLoop - I reverted that with the third commit
* I pointed to the wrong branch of OmnipodKit - I fixed that with the fourth commit

### Details

This listing shows the explicit updates for the submodules in this PR (the SHA for each after PR is merged). 

> If there is a plus sign in front of the submodule, it will be updated to that SHA with this PR.

```
 % git submodule status
 4f8c3a8cb50e68a979bdbed2e207aca00e4b35e0 AccuChekKit (heads/master)
+ea224e771fb3329a957a753296232c62a003a9fe CGMBLEKit (v3.1-206-gea224e7)
+e157a861c691f44c84df6071233edb935c06e7dc DanaKit (heads/dev)
+e1bb6faf01bb4bd79872ae6d12787aea8bfe2ad5 EversenseKit (heads/dev)
+dd91f465b8b7392354b74463b9b9cc7aae32db9f G7SensorKit (heads/main)
 24d5617f703089a36f4261c3ab84f2ac505a8f1a LibreCRKit (heads/trio)
 d98a9ee52398c1e867f7c044b1dc10e6aaa8fce0 LibreLoop (remotes/origin/trio)
+41105123c3c4fb5c55ce89a38630cea2f8f7a17a LibreTransmitter (heads/main)
+4604ee36f5acc3d00b2d07331a3a477570761374 LoopAlgorithm (heads/main)
+f974241f5f25053d51da3e80833c85b13c387e6f LoopKit (v3.0-1132-gf974241f)
+ef866fa68db22932271af9bce86372ced8604203 MedtrumKit (heads/dev)
+a7b26858e3073ac8881e7303b675c6b0f8c51ee9 MinimedKit (heads/main)
+043b91dbf1958d26c55d927a6a8d651bc91f208d OmnipodKit (heads/dev)
+049f0d51b2fb90fa5180f3f62555d8c661b55968 RileyLinkKit (heads/dev)
+99ac3544f8462973f6ea886d1a46c2954ad0cc0f TidepoolService (heads/dev)
+ff0d71433447af3c93dac450d95c14b63f58f417 dexcom-share-client-swift (v0.4.1-180-gff0d714)
```

### Test

Ensure PR builds from the branch in this PR.

Comment: The following submodules are modified by building as are the following Trio files.

I cannot change the submodules at this time, but I can include the Trio updates upon request. Note - this build was with Xcode 27.

submodules:
```
	modified:   EversenseKit (modified content)
	modified:   LibreLoop (modified content)
```

Trio files (I know the first two change just by switching between Xcode 26 and 27)
```
	modified:   Trio.xcodeproj/xcshareddata/xcschemes/Trio Watch App.xcscheme
	modified:   Trio.xcodeproj/xcshareddata/xcschemes/Trio Watch Complication Extension.xcscheme
	modified:   Trio/Sources/Localizations/Main/Localizable.xcstrings
	modified:   Trio/Sources/Modules/Home/HomeStateModel.swift
	modified:   Trio/Sources/Modules/Treatments/View/TreatmentsRootView.swift
```
